name: Rockfish Island
source:
You're on your way to a concert overseas. You and your bandmates  board the plane. The plane that will never make it to its destination.

[From [url=https://lavender-lemon.itch.io/rockfish-island]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你正準備前往海外參加一場演唱會。你和樂團夥伴們登上了飛機。這架飛機，卻永遠無法抵達目的地。

[摘自[url=https://lavender-lemon.itch.io/rockfish-island]itch.io[/url]]
